---
title: "Explore the evidence"
subtitle: "Query AREE's harmonized evidence, candidates and studies in your browser"
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

This page runs [DuckDB](https://duckdb.org/docs/api/wasm/overview) inside your browser
against Parquet exports of AREE's pipeline outputs (`aree export-site-data`). SQL executes locally; the browser fetches scripts and data from public servers.
Selective queries can fetch only the Parquet portions they need, while broad queries
may read most of a table. For conversational
access through Claude or another MCP client, see [Querying AREE](querying_aree.md).

::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple"}
**How to read these results.** Evidence records are statistical associations from individual
studies. A significant record or a high candidate score is not a validated biomarker and does
not establish causation; *emerging*-tier candidates require replication. Rows with
`simulated = true` come from synthetic demo studies and are not real findings.
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
meta = fetch(new URL("explore/data/meta.json", document.baseURI)).then(r => {
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error("explore/data/meta.json not found — run `aree export-site-data` before `quarto render docs`.");
  return r.json();
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
duckdb = import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@duckdb/duckdb-wasm@1.29.0/+esm")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// One DuckDB instance; each table is a view over its Parquet file, read by HTTP range request.
conn = {
  const bundle = await duckdb.selectBundle(duckdb.getJsDelivrBundles());
  const workerUrl = URL.createObjectURL(
    new Blob([`importScripts("${bundle.mainWorker}");`], {type: "text/javascript"}));
  const db = new duckdb.AsyncDuckDB(new duckdb.VoidLogger(), new Worker(workerUrl));
  await db.instantiate(bundle.mainModule, bundle.pthreadWorker);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(workerUrl);
  const base = new URL("explore/data/", document.baseURI).href;
  const c = await db.connect();
  for (const t of Object.keys(meta.tables)) {
    await db.registerFileURL(`${t}.parquet`, base + meta.tables[t].file, duckdb.DuckDBDataProtocol.HTTP, false);
    await c.query(`CREATE VIEW ${t} AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('${t}.parquet')`);
  }
  return c;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Run SQL; return plain objects (BigInt -> Number) for Inputs.table and Plot.
async function sql(q) {
  const result = await conn.query(q);
  return result.toArray().map(row => {
    const o = row.toJSON();
    for (const k in o) if (typeof o[k] === "bigint") o[k] = Number(o[k]);
    return o;
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
lit = s => `'${String(s).replace(/'/g, "''")}'`
inList = (col, values) => values.length ? `AND ${col} IN (${values.map(lit).join(", ")})` : ""
simClause = includeSim => includeSim ? "" : "AND NOT simulated"
phenoLabel = id => meta.labels.phenotype[id] ?? id
stressorLabel = id => meta.labels.stressor[id] ?? id
// Preserve tiny probabilities instead of Inputs.table rounding them to zero.
pFormat = p => p == null ? "—" : p === 0 ? "0 (reported/underflow)" : p < 0.001 ? p.toExponential(2) : p.toPrecision(3)
pFormats = ({p_value: pFormat, adjusted_p_value: pFormat})

function downloadButton(rows, filename, label = "Download CSV") {
  const button = html`<button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary">${label} (${rows.length.toLocaleString()} rows)</button>`;
  button.onclick = () => {
    const cols = rows.length ? Object.keys(rows[0]) : [];
    const esc = v => v == null ? "" : /[",\n]/.test(String(v)) ? `"${String(v).replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : String(v);
    const csv = [cols.join(","), ...rows.map(r => cols.map(c => esc(r[c])).join(","))].join("\n");
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv], {type: "text/csv"}));
    a.download = filename;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
  };
  return button;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<p class="text-muted small">Data exported ${new Date(meta.generated).toLocaleString()} ·
AREE ${meta.aree_version} ·
${meta.tables.evidence.real.toLocaleString()} real + ${meta.tables.evidence.simulated.toLocaleString()} simulated evidence records ·
${meta.tables.candidates.total.toLocaleString()} ranked candidates ·
${meta.tables.studies.total} registered studies</p>`
```

## Gene / feature lookup

Search a standardized or original identifier, or an orthogroup. Real oyster identifiers
include NCBI GeneIDs such as `105333935`. Symbol matching works only when the symbol
is an original identifier; use the Candidates tab to search gene names and descriptions.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof featureQuery = Inputs.text({placeholder: "Feature identifier…", submit: "Search", width: 360})
viewof lookupSim = Inputs.toggle({label: "Include simulated", value: false})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Two steps, so a lookup never scans the full evidence file:
// 1. resolve the query against the small `features` index (exact id match, else substring);
// 2. fetch evidence by exact id. evidence.parquet is sorted by standardized id, then
//    original id, so DuckDB skips every row group whose min/max excludes the ids.
lookup = {
  const q = featureQuery.trim();
  if (!q) return null;
  const lq = lit(q.toLowerCase());
  const idCols = ["feature_id_standardized", "feature_id_original", "orthogroup_id"];
  const sim = simClause(lookupSim);
  let ids = await sql(`SELECT DISTINCT feature_id_standardized AS std, feature_id_original AS orig FROM features
    WHERE (${idCols.map(c => `lower(${c}) = ${lq}`).join(" OR ")}) ${sim} LIMIT 200`);
  if (!ids.length) {
    const like = lit(`%${q.toLowerCase()}%`);
    ids = await sql(`SELECT DISTINCT feature_id_standardized AS std, feature_id_original AS orig FROM features
      WHERE (${idCols.map(c => `lower(${c}) LIKE ${like}`).join(" OR ")}) ${sim}
      ORDER BY std NULLS LAST, orig LIMIT 200`);
  }
  const std = [...new Set(ids.filter(d => d.std != null).map(d => d.std))].slice(0, 50);
  const orig = [...new Set(ids.filter(d => d.std == null).map(d => d.orig))].slice(0, 50);
  // One equality branch per id: DuckDB prunes row groups for `=`, not for a multi-value IN.
  const branches = [
    ...std.map(id => `SELECT * FROM evidence WHERE feature_id_standardized = ${lit(id)} ${sim}`),
    ...orig.map(id => `SELECT * FROM evidence WHERE feature_id_standardized IS NULL
                         AND feature_id_original = ${lit(id)} ${sim}`),
  ];
  if (!branches.length) return [];
  return sql(`SELECT * FROM (${branches.join("\nUNION ALL\n")})
    ORDER BY feature_id_standardized, adjusted_p_value NULLS LAST LIMIT 5000`);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
lookupSummary = {
  if (lookup === null) return html`<p class="text-muted">Enter an identifier and press Search.</p>`;
  if (!lookup.length) return html`<p>No evidence records match <code>${featureQuery}</code>.</p>`;
  const features = new Set(lookup.map(d => d.feature_id_standardized));
  const studies = new Set(lookup.map(d => d.study_id));
  const sig = lookup.filter(d => d.adjusted_p_value != null && d.adjusted_p_value <= 0.05);
  const up = sig.filter(d => d.molecular_direction === "up").length;
  const down = sig.filter(d => d.molecular_direction === "down").length;
  return html`<p><strong>${lookup.length.toLocaleString()}</strong> records ·
    <strong>${features.size}</strong> standardized feature(s) · <strong>${studies.size}</strong> studies ·
    ${sig.length} with adjusted p ≤ 0.05 (${up} up, ${down} down)
    ${lookup.length === 5000 ? html` · <em>showing the first 5,000</em>` : ""}</p>
    ${up && down ? html`<div class="callout callout-style-simple callout-note"><div class="callout-body">
      Significant records disagree in direction. That is reported, not averaged away: check
      whether the phenotypes, tissues or life stages differ.</div></div>` : ""}`;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
lookupPlot = {
  if (!lookup || !lookup.length) return html``;
  const features = new Set(lookup.map(d => d.feature_id_standardized));
  if (features.size > 1) return html`<p class="text-muted small">Effect plot shown when the search narrows to one standardized feature (${features.size} matched).</p>`;
  const rows = lookup.filter(d => d.effect_size != null).map(d => ({
    ...d, row: `${d.study_id} · ${d.comparison_id}`, sig: d.adjusted_p_value != null && d.adjusted_p_value <= 0.05}));
  return Plot.plot({
    marginLeft: 280, height: Math.max(120, 26 * rows.length + 60), width,
    x: {label: "Effect size →", grid: true},
    y: {label: null},
    color: {legend: true, label: "Effect-size type"},
    caption: "Effect-size types differ by assay (e.g. log2 fold change vs. methylation difference); compare within a type. Filled = adjusted p ≤ 0.05.",
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleX([0], {stroke: "currentColor", strokeOpacity: 0.4}),
      Plot.ruleY(rows.filter(d => d.ci_lower != null && d.ci_upper != null),
        {y: "row", x1: "ci_lower", x2: "ci_upper", stroke: "effect_size_type"}),
      Plot.dot(rows.filter(d => d.sig), {y: "row", x: "effect_size", fill: "effect_size_type", r: 4}),
      Plot.dot(rows, {y: "row", x: "effect_size", stroke: "effect_size_type", r: 4,
        title: d => `${d.study_id} · ${d.comparison_id}\n${phenoLabel(d.phenotype)} / ${stressorLabel(d.stressor)}\n${d.tissue}, ${d.life_stage}\neffect ${d.effect_size} (${d.effect_size_type}), adj p ${d.adjusted_p_value}\nmapping: ${d.mapping_confidence}${d.simulated ? "\nSIMULATED" : ""}`})
    ]
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
lookup && lookup.length ? html`${downloadButton(lookup, `aree_${featureQuery.trim()}_evidence.csv`)}
${Inputs.table(lookup, {rows: 15, format: pFormats, columns: ["study_id", "comparison_id", "simulated", "feature_id_original",
  "feature_id_standardized", "feature_type", "mapping_confidence", "molecular_direction", "effect_size",
  "effect_size_type", "ci_lower", "ci_upper", "adjusted_p_value", "sample_size", "phenotype", "stressor",
  "tissue", "life_stage", "quality_flags", "source_file", "workflow_version"]})}` : html``
```

## Candidates

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof candFilters = Inputs.form({
  phenotype: Inputs.select(meta.facets.candidates.phenotype ?? [], {label: "Phenotype", multiple: true, format: phenoLabel}),
  tier: Inputs.select(meta.facets.candidates.tier ?? [], {label: "Tier", multiple: true}),
  evidence_class: Inputs.select(meta.facets.candidates.evidence_class ?? [], {label: "Evidence class", multiple: true}),
  contrast_type: Inputs.select(meta.facets.candidates.contrast_type ?? [], {label: "Contrast type", multiple: true}),
  predictiveOnly: Inputs.toggle({label: "Predictive baseline only", value: false}),
  feature: Inputs.text({label: "Gene ID or name contains", placeholder: "optional"}),
  includeSim: Inputs.toggle({label: "Include simulated", value: false})
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
candidates = sql(`
  SELECT feature_id_standardized, gene_symbol, gene_description, feature_type, phenotype, simulated,
         species_taxid, tier, evidence_class, contrast_type, is_predictive_baseline,
         context_replication, score, k_studies, n_supporting_layers, direction_consistency,
         pooled_effect, i_squared, adjusted_p_value, studies
  FROM candidates
  WHERE TRUE ${inList("phenotype", candFilters.phenotype)} ${inList("tier", candFilters.tier)}
        ${inList("evidence_class", candFilters.evidence_class)} ${inList("contrast_type", candFilters.contrast_type)}
        ${candFilters.predictiveOnly ? "AND is_predictive_baseline" : ""} ${simClause(candFilters.includeSim)}
        ${candFilters.feature.trim() ? (() => { const q = lit(`%${candFilters.feature.trim().toLowerCase()}%`);
          return `AND (lower(feature_id_standardized) LIKE ${q} OR lower(coalesce(gene_symbol, '')) LIKE ${q}
                       OR lower(coalesce(gene_description, '')) LIKE ${q})`; })() : ""}
  ORDER BY CASE tier WHEN 'high_priority_cross_study' THEN 0 WHEN 'multi_omics_convergence' THEN 1
                     WHEN 'metabolite_linked_convergence' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, score DESC
  LIMIT 20000`)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<p>${candidates.length.toLocaleString()} candidates ${candidates.length === 20000 ? "(first 20,000)" : ""}
  ${downloadButton(candidates, "aree_candidates.csv")}</p>
  ${Inputs.table(candidates, {rows: 20, format: {...pFormats, phenotype: phenoLabel}})}`
```

**Tiers.** *high_priority_cross_study*: ≥2 independent studies, consistent direction, acceptable
quality, BH-adjusted pooled p ≤ 0.05. *multi_omics_convergence*: significant in ≥2 molecular layers
for the same feature and phenotype. *metabolite_linked_convergence*: linked through KEGG reaction annotation or a curated transporter–substrate assignment (weaker). *emerging*: single-study or unconfirmed, **requires replication**.
`evidence_class` says what the evidence is *of*: only `resilience_associated` rests on a measured
resilience outcome. See [Interpreting candidate scores](interpreting_candidate_scores.md).
`contrast_type` says between whom and when: *baseline_phenotype_difference* compares groups that differ
in resilience under common unstressed conditions, the design for a marker that could be read before any
stress; *exposure_response* is a treatment against its control. **Predictive baseline only** keeps
baseline contrasts with a resilience outcome (`is_predictive_baseline`). See
[Contrast types](contrast_types.md).

## Filter evidence

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof evFilters = Inputs.form({
  phenotype: Inputs.select(meta.facets.evidence.phenotype ?? [], {label: "Phenotype", multiple: true, format: phenoLabel}),
  stressor: Inputs.select(meta.facets.evidence.stressor ?? [], {label: "Stressor", multiple: true, format: stressorLabel}),
  species: Inputs.select(meta.facets.evidence.species ?? [], {label: "Species", multiple: true}),
  feature_type: Inputs.select(meta.facets.evidence.feature_type ?? [], {label: "Feature type", multiple: true}),
  tissue: Inputs.select(meta.facets.evidence.tissue ?? [], {label: "Tissue", multiple: true}),
  maxP: Inputs.select([0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 1], {label: "Adjusted p ≤", value: 0.05}),
  includeSim: Inputs.toggle({label: "Include simulated", value: false})
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Runs only on click: a broad filter scans the whole evidence file, which should never
// happen just because the page loaded (Observable cells run even in hidden tabs).
viewof evApplied = Inputs.button("Apply filters", {value: null, reduce: () => (viewof evFilters).value})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
evResult = {
  if (evApplied === null) return null;
  const f = evApplied;
  const where = `WHERE TRUE ${inList("phenotype", f.phenotype)} ${inList("stressor", f.stressor)}
    ${inList("species", f.species)} ${inList("feature_type", f.feature_type)}
    ${inList("tissue", f.tissue)} ${simClause(f.includeSim)}
    ${f.maxP < 1 ? `AND adjusted_p_value <= ${f.maxP}` : ""}`;
  const [count] = await sql(`SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT study_id) AS studies,
    count(DISTINCT feature_id_standardized) AS features FROM evidence ${where}`);
  const rows = await sql(`SELECT * FROM evidence ${where} ORDER BY adjusted_p_value NULLS LAST LIMIT 10000`);
  return {count, rows};
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
evResult === null
  ? html`<p class="text-muted">Choose filters and press <strong>Apply filters</strong>. Broad filters read most of the evidence file (~${Math.round(meta.tables.evidence.total / 1000).toLocaleString()}k records) and can take a few seconds.</p>`
  : html`<p><strong>${evResult.count.n.toLocaleString()}</strong> records · ${evResult.count.features.toLocaleString()} features ·
  ${evResult.count.studies} studies ${evResult.count.n > 10000 ? "· table and download hold the 10,000 most significant" : ""}
  ${downloadButton(evResult.rows, "aree_evidence_filtered.csv")}</p>
  ${Inputs.table(evResult.rows, {rows: 20, format: pFormats, columns: ["study_id", "comparison_id", "simulated", "feature_id_standardized",
    "feature_id_original", "feature_type", "molecular_direction", "effect_size", "effect_size_type",
    "adjusted_p_value", "phenotype", "stressor", "tissue", "life_stage", "species", "mapping_confidence",
    "quality_flags"]})}`
```

## SQL

Tables: `evidence`, `candidates`, `studies`. Queries run locally in your browser
(DuckDB SQL dialect); results display up to 5,000 rows.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
examples = new Map([
  ["Genes significant in ≥3 real studies", `SELECT feature_id_standardized, phenotype,
       count(DISTINCT study_id) AS n_studies,
       sum(CASE WHEN molecular_direction = 'up' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_up,
       sum(CASE WHEN molecular_direction = 'down' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_down
FROM evidence
WHERE NOT simulated AND feature_type = 'gene' AND adjusted_p_value <= 0.05
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING n_studies >= 3
ORDER BY n_studies DESC, feature_id_standardized
LIMIT 200`],
  ["Features with conflicting significant directions", `SELECT feature_id_standardized, feature_type,
       list(DISTINCT study_id) AS studies,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE molecular_direction = 'up') AS n_up,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE molecular_direction = 'down') AS n_down
FROM evidence
WHERE adjusted_p_value <= 0.05 AND NOT simulated
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING n_up > 0 AND n_down > 0
ORDER BY n_up + n_down DESC
LIMIT 200`],
  ["Evidence volume by phenotype and stressor", `SELECT phenotype, stressor, simulated,
       count(DISTINCT study_id) AS studies, count(*) AS records,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE adjusted_p_value <= 0.05) AS significant
FROM evidence
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY records DESC`],
  ["Resilience-associated high-priority candidates", `SELECT *
FROM candidates
WHERE tier = 'high_priority_cross_study' AND evidence_class = 'resilience_associated'
ORDER BY score DESC`],
  ["Predictive baseline candidates (significant)", `SELECT feature_id_standardized, gene_symbol, gene_description,
       phenotype, tier, score, k_studies, pooled_effect, adjusted_p_value, studies
FROM candidates
WHERE is_predictive_baseline AND adjusted_p_value <= 0.05 AND NOT simulated
ORDER BY adjusted_p_value`],
  ["Mapping confidence of significant records", `SELECT mapping_confidence, count(*) AS records
FROM evidence
WHERE adjusted_p_value <= 0.05
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY records DESC`]
])
viewof example = Inputs.select(examples, {label: "Example"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof sqlText = Inputs.textarea({value: example, rows: 12, width: Math.min(width, 900),
  spellcheck: false, monospace: true})
viewof sqlRun = Inputs.button("Run query", {value: null, reduce: () => (viewof sqlText).value})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sqlResult = sqlRun === null ? null : sql(sqlRun).then(rows => ({rows}), error => ({error}))
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sqlResult === null ? html`<p class="text-muted">Edit the query (or pick an example) and press <strong>Run query</strong>.</p>`
  : sqlResult.error
  ? html`<div class="alert alert-danger"><pre style="white-space: pre-wrap; margin: 0">${sqlResult.error.message}</pre></div>`
  : html`<p>${sqlResult.rows.length.toLocaleString()} rows ${downloadButton(sqlResult.rows, "aree_query.csv")}</p>
    ${Inputs.table(sqlResult.rows.slice(0, 5000), {rows: 20, format: pFormats})}`
```
